title: Beef Stew
description: A hearty beef stew recipe perfect for a cold winter's day. The addition of gooey cheese and zesty spices takes this classic dish to the next level.

ingredients.name: zesty seasoning
ingredients.notes: such as paprika and garlic powder

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef on all sides, then set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the onion, carrot, and potato until the vegetables are tender.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the browned beef back in, along with the beef broth, gooseberries, and zesty seasoning.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2.5 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Stir in the gooey cheese until melted and well combined.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve with crusty bread or over egg noodles.
